user_prompt: In adults and adolescents (≥12 years) with non-allergic rhinitis, what is the effect of intranasal corticosteroids compared with placebo on the risk of epistaxis (nosebleed), measured at any point during treatment or follow-up? Extract only epistaxis as a dichotomous adverse event (number of participants experiencing epistaxis and total participants per arm). Include epistaxis whether actively assessed, spontaneously reported, or recorded in a diary/questionnaire. Pool using risk difference (RD). For multi-dose trials, use an intranasal corticosteroid dose within 200–400 µg/day and avoid double-counting a shared placebo group. Exclude other adverse events, nasal symptom scores, quality of life, and airflow outcomes. Exclude protocols and non-RCTs.
